descriptionChirho: A person consecrated to God by a special vow involving abstinence from wine, not cutting the hair, and avoiding corpse-impurity (Num 6), used in singular and plural with various inflections.
One set apart or distinguished among peers, used of Joseph as the one separated from his brothers (Gen 49:26; Deut 33:16) and of the nobles or princes of Jerusalem (Lam 4:7).
An untended grapevine that grows of itself during the sabbatical or jubilee year, left uncut and unharvested (Lev 25:5, 11).
